questions: Were you born before January 2, 1961? A person reaches age 65 on the day before their 65th birthday, so a birthday of January 1, 1961 counts and January 2, 1961 does not. If this return is for someone who died in 2025 before reaching age 65, answer no.

Were you totally blind on December 31, 2025, or do you have a statement certified by your eye doctor (ophthalmologist or optometrist) that you can't see better than 20/200 in your better eye with glasses or contact lenses, or that your field of vision is 20 degrees or less?
